operator-walkthrough.ref: Admin UI v1 Wave 3, what the crew sees on an iPhone after this merges. Tap Lot in the bottom bar: the page opens on who is on the lot right now as ruled 48 px rows, longest wait first, each with the plate (or 'Plate not read'), a detail line that leads with 'needs staff confirm' or an unobserved arrival before the stage and customer match, the time on the lot, a 'Quote a walk-in' button and a 'More' button that shows the full detail and the mark buttons. A 48 px 'Quote a walk-in' button sits under the header, so quoting a walk-in is two taps (Lot, Quote) instead of three through Search. Below the board: the four counters as one strip (on a desktop they stand beside the board), then a collapsed 'Checks' rail holding the camera trust chips and every other Lot panel (busy hours, time to bay, bays, identity confidence, conversations, cameras, commissioning, recent visits); nothing was removed. The rail's summary counts what is not healthy and every input that did not answer ('N unknown'), and says 'all healthy' only when every read answered. The floor board shows even when the counters' read fails; a read paused because the phone is offline says 'Offline, not checked' instead of loading forever. On Approvals, Approve still takes two taps and still says it runs immediately, but its confirm is no longer a red danger dialog; Reject stays red. Six-feet gate: Lot at 390 scores 0.518 against the frozen pre-W1 render (gate 0.35; it read 0.172 before), Today holds 0.359. Tests: client/src/__tests__/admin-w3-lot-board.test.tsx and admin-w3-approve-tone.test.tsx; 141 client files / 1,994 tests green on the combined tree. Not device-tested: Nour's own look on his phone is owed after the deploy.
